description: Use this when the user wants a manual pre-launch checklist for a Lovable + Supabase app or a Next.js + Supabase app on Vercel. Returns the checklist published on viberaven.dev for that stack with its sources, and the one optional local VibeRaven step (`npx -y viberaven@1.6.6 check`), which is advice, not a gate. The items are manual checks the user does in their dashboards and code; this tool does not run any of them.

stack.description: lovable-supabase for a Lovable app with Supabase, nextjs-supabase-vercel for a Next.js app with Supabase deployed on Vercel.

name: launch_checklist
title: Get a launch checklist
